''The Yellow Army'' | founded = {{Start date and age|1912|09|19|df=y}} | stadium = [[Rat Verlegh Stadion]] | capacity = 20,500 {{Cite web|url=https://www.nac.nl/nieuws/update-verbouwing-rat-verlegh-stadion-betonconstructies-en-uitbreiding-tribunes|title=Update verbouwing Rat Verlegh Stadion|website=NAC Breda}} | chairman = Henk van Koeveringe | mgrtitle = Head coach | manager = [[Rick Kruys]] | owner = NAC=Breda{{cite web |url=https://www.bndestem.nl/nac/nac-breda-officieel-de-nieuwe-eigenaar-van-nac-na-bezoek-aan-de-notaris~a01b8969/ |language=nl-nl |date=11 August 2022 |access-date=28 December 2022 |title=NAC=Breda officieel de nieuwe eigenaar van NAC na bezoek aan de notaris |publisher=BN de Stem}} | league = {{Dutch football updater|NACBreda}} | season = {{Dutch football updater|NACBreda2}} | position = {{Dutch football updater|NACBreda3}} | current = 2025–26 NAC Breda season | pattern_la1 = | pattern_b1 = _nac2526h | pattern_ra1 = | pattern_sh1 = _monterrey1213t1 | pattern_so1 = | leftarm1 = FFFF00 | body1 = FFFF00 | rightarm1 = FFFF00 | shorts1 = 000000 | socks1 = FFFFF | pattern_la2 = | pattern_b2 = _nac2526t | pattern_ra2 = | pattern_sh2 = _monterrey1213t1 | pattern_so2 = _monterrey1213t1 | leftarm2 = 000000 | body2 = 000000 | rightarm2 = 000000 | shorts2 = 000000 | socks2 = 000000 | pattern_la3 = | pattern_b3 = _nac2526a | pattern_ra3 = | pattern_sh3 = | pattern_so3 = | leftarm3 = 5F04B4 | body3 = 5F04B4 | rightarm3 = 5F04B4 | shorts3 = 5F04B4 | socks3 = 5F04B4 | website = {{URL|http://www.nac.nl}} }} '''NAC Breda''' ({{IPA|nl|nɑɡ breːˈdaː}}), often simply known as '''NAC''', is a Dutch professional [[football club (association football)|football club]], based in [[Breda]], Netherlands. NAC Breda play in the [[Rat Verlegh Stadion|Rat Verlegh Stadium]], named after their most important player, [[Antoon Verlegh|Antoon 'Rat' Verlegh]]. The club competes in the [[Eerste Divisie]], the second tier of [[Dutch football league system|Dutch football]], following relegation from the [[Eredivisie]] in the [[2025–26 Eredivisie|2025–26 season]]. In their history, NAC won one national title in [[1920–21 Netherlands Football League Championship|1921]] and won one [[KNVB Cup]] in [[1972–73 KNVB Cup|1973]]. NAC was founded on 19 September 1912, when the two clubs ADVENDO and NOAD merged to one club, both being abbreviations of their respective full names. In August 2012, NAC reinstated their first crest as the new club logo for the 2012–13 season.{{cite web|url=http://www.nac.nl/nieuws/36287/nac-presenteert-jubileumlogo.html|title=Dutch article official NAC website|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120719085125/http://www.nac.nl/nieuws/36287/nac-presenteert-jubileumlogo.html|archive-date=19 July 2012}}"}}
